items.project_definition: A synchronization gate ensuring all blocking infrastructure is verified before parallel feature development commences.
The critical infrastructure layer containing shared serialization and I/O logic that blocks all subsequent user story implementation.
The primary functional objective a user must achieve within a specific feature set.
A sequential alphanumeric token assigned to each entry to ensure unique reference and retrieval.
The lightweight data-interchange format used for persistent storage and scriptable output.
The minimum viable product consisting of the most critical feature set required for initial validation.
The structural grouping of implementation units by their corresponding user story to ensure independent testability.
The set of design and contract documents required before implementation begins.
The primary documentation file detailing usage and storage behavior.
The initial phase focused on package skeleton creation and tooling configuration.
The specific implementation unit responsible for handling empty collection states with user-facing messages.
The verification suite comprising unit and integration directories to validate system behavior.
The process of assigning a timestamp to the creation field during entry instantiation.
The operation that purges all entries marked as finished from the persistent store.
The operation that retrieves and displays all stored entries in either human-readable or machine-parseable formats.
A high-priority constraint indicating that subsequent work is strictly blocked until the current phase is finalized.
